gifts.title: Your Year In Tides
gifts.about: A whole year of tides at your place, drawn as rings, like the rings of a tree: the year someone was born, the year you married, the year you moved to the coast, or a year still ahead.

gifts.title: Beach Wedding Welcome Sign
gifts.about: A welcome sign for a wedding by the water: the predicted tide at your town or beach on your wedding day, with the time of your ceremony marked on the curve.

gifts.title: New Home Tide Chart Print
gifts.about: A custom tide chart print of the day you got the keys, made to order as a digital file: a housewarming, first home or closing day gift.

gifts.title: New Grandparents Tide Chart Print
gifts.about: A custom tide chart print of the day they became grandparents, made to order as a digital file: a gift for a new grandma and grandpa.

gifts.title: Beach Vacation Tide Chart Print
gifts.about: A custom tide chart print of a day on your beach vacation, made to order as a digital file: a keepsake of a family trip or a honeymoon.

gifts.title: Adoption Day Tide Chart Print
gifts.about: A custom tide chart print of your adoption day, made to order as a digital file: a keepsake of the day you became a family.

gifts.about: Every day of 2027 in your city, drawn as light: a ring of 365 spokes, one for each day, with the hours the sun is up as a band of gold (or coral) around it. Made to order for any city in the world with a sunrise and a sunset every day of the year.

gifts.title: Your Town's Typical Year
gifts.about: A year of normal weather in your town, drawn as one picture: 365 thin strokes, one for each day from January 1 to December 31, each running from that day's normal low up to its normal high. Under them, a second row shows each day's normal precipitation. Made to order from NOAA's 1991–2020 climate normals for a weather station near your town.
